resources.string: Debug only. Uses a disposable key and random test data. Creates no pairing and approves nothing. The key stays across restarts until you delete it. Enrollment retention is experimental.
Create or inspect the probe key to begin.
Try a new signature without a prompt

Experiment failed: %1$s. The probe did not delete an existing key.
FAIL: A new signature succeeded without authentication. Do not use this key for approvals.
PASS: The new signature required authentication.
Remozio debug experiment. No real approval.
Test signature verified (%1$d DER bytes). No real approval was sent.
Authentication ended (code %1$d). No test signature was accepted.
Debug experiment. This checks discovery and TCP reachability on this phone. It does not enable debugging, pair a host, send ADB commands, or open a tunnel.
Select this phone in the system picker. A matching advertisement is a candidate, not proof of ADB identity. No broad LAN permission is requested.
Use the current connection port from Wireless debugging, or a legacy port you already enabled. Only loopback is contacted.
Waiting for the system picker. This experiment stops discovery after 90 seconds.
Discovery timed out. No result is inferred.
Candidate port: %1$d. Its advertisement matches an address on this phone. Select a loopback test to check reachability. ADB identity is unverified.
The selected service does not match this phone. The port was not changed.
Could not establish a local candidate. The port was not changed.
Android rejected discovery with code %1$d. No connection was attempted.
Checking one loopback port. The connection timeout is 3 seconds.
TCP connection accepted and closed. No data was sent. ADB identity and authorization remain unverified.
Connection refused. No listener was reached at this address and port.
Connection timed out. This does not identify a permission or listener failure.
Android denied this connection. No ADB operation ran.
The connection could not be checked. No ADB result is inferred.
